scope: Final reviewed public software snapshot. No game, browser, or live game API validation.
validationNotes: Earlier export attempts exposed missing derived source paths and old byte digests; final catalog paths and digests were repaired without changing the research originals.
Sandboxed loopback tests were blocked with EACCES; the same four checks passed outside that restriction.
A public vendor directory and a short character-name collision were corrected in pseudonymization; general game terminology is retained.
Final published Git-normalized bytes are indexed separately in PUBLICATION_MANIFEST.json; remote CI is attached to the pushed commit.
limitations: Tests establish software consistency, not current-game coefficient, timing, card-source attribution, or equipment superiority.
The original linked combat-cycle goal remains incomplete.
Full historical raw research and video captures are local-only.
No guarantee against every vulnerability; research and development are stopped.
